messages.label: EMIT AgentEvent (CAPABILITY_RESOLVED | CAPABILITY_RESOLUTION_FAILED)
messages.note: resolveModelProposedToolCall: ¿response.proposedToolCall == NULL? → HarnessError RESOLUTION_REQUESTED_WITHOUT_PROPOSAL (VALIDATION). Busca en registeredCapabilities un CapabilityDescriptor cuyo name coincida con proposedToolCall.capabilityName: no encontrado → HarnessError CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND (VALIDATION); encontrado con argumentsMatchSchema = FALSE → HarnessError TOOL_INPUT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH (VALIDATION); encontrado con argumentsMatchSchema = TRUE → construye ToolCall (capability tomado del descriptor resuelto)
